profile_text.body:
Runway is a for-profit startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, NY. On its own site the company describes itself as building foundational "Real-World Intelligence" that can understand, simulate and act in the world, with products and services built on top of that intelligence. It says its components, from policy inference and evaluation to synthetic data generation, are powered by GWM-1, which it calls a state-of-the-art General World Model, and it presents Solaris as its first Interface World Model, described as real-time AI that generates interactive interfaces frame by frame without code. The site also markets enterprise video generation, citing themes such as data sovereignty, cost economics, autonomous execution and model ownership. The site's product listing tracks Runway under video generation and editing.

The company's litigation record includes four cases naming Runway AI, Inc.: David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc. and Businessing LLC v. Runway AI, Inc., both in the District Court for the Southern District of New York; a second David Vance Gardner v. Runway AI, Inc. in the Central District of California; and Ace Cam, Inc. v. Runway AI Inc in the Southern District of New York. The record also lists Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd. in the Northern District of California. A litigation exposure tally for New York counts 458 cases.
